title: poa spiciformis
intro: Poa spiciformis, commonly known as Spike-awned Meadow-grass, is a species of grass native to China and the Himalayas. The plant is used in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa spiciformis include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative effects. The bioactive constituents of Poa spiciformis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
